evidence.trl_pathway: Most TRL progressions are reasonable: T02 (TRL7, 2yr development), T03 (TRL6, 1yr), T07 (TRL6, 1yr) are all plausible; T06 (TRL4→completion in 2yr) and T10 (TRL5, 1yr) are slightly aggressive but not infeasible given the dependency chain provides foundation work.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio includes lower-TRL exploratory technologies (T06 TRL4, T10 TRL5, T04 TRL5) consistent with 기술선도, and the domain alignment is strong; however, anchoring on T02 at TRL7 (already near-commercial) and clustering 3 of 6 technologies as 'Strategic' tier with high market_opp scores suggests commercialization pressure mixed into a supposed technology leadership strategy.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All six technologies are firmly within the Conversational AI / LLM / Knowledge Graph domain — graph accelerators, transformer optimization, knowledge graph automation, and data lineage are all core competencies for this domain, demonstrating strong domain fit and differentiation awareness.
evidence.market_timing: The mean timing error of 2.29 years is very high for any strategy; for 기술선도, preemption requires completing 1-2 years BEFORE boom, but most technologies complete 2-3.5 years AFTER their boom windows (T07 misses by 3.5yr, T06 by 3.25yr, T10 by 2.5yr), which undermines the leadership positioning entirely.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selection of knowledge graph and transformer optimization technologies aligns with active patent domains in AI/LLM, and market scores are reasonably differentiated (3-5 range), but there is no explicit evidence of deliberate convergence-zone targeting — the overlap appears partially incidental given domain focus rather than analytically driven.

weaknesses: Severe market timing misalignment across the portfolio — 5 of 6 technologies complete after their boom windows, with errors up to 3.5 years, negating any technology leadership preemption advantage
The strategic direction of 기술선도 is undermined by heavy weighting of near-market technologies (T02 TRL7, T03 TRL6) as Strategic tier investments rather than deeper exploratory bets
missing_technologies: Low-TRL foundational LLM reasoning or multi-agent orchestration framework (TRL 2-3) to genuinely anchor a technology leadership pipeline
Federated knowledge graph or privacy-preserving LLM training technology to differentiate in the emerging regulatory landscape
investment_issues: T02 at TRL7 receiving 'Strategic' tier investment is misaligned with 기술선도 — resources allocated to near-mature technology crowd out earlier-stage exploratory investment
T04 (암시적 데이터 의존성 감사) rated Medium tier with low urgency (2.0) yet has no dependencies and could be accelerated independently to better capture its 2028-Q2 boom window
timing_issues: T07 (맥락 기반 접근 지능 보안 관리) completes 3.5 years after its 2026-Q3 boom — the market window will have largely passed by 2030-Q1
T06 (Sliceout 기반 트랜스포머 학습 최적화) boom is 2026-Q4 but completion is 2030-Q1, a 3.25-year miss that makes the 'High' tier investment questionable in ROI terms
The sequential dependency chain (T02→T03→T07, T02→T03→T10) structurally delays downstream technologies well past their individual market windows
